# Combat > Attacks

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md)*

Making attacks: attack rolls, weapons, cover, critical hits, grappling and opportunity attacks.

## Entries

- [Attack Roll](Attack-Roll.md): An attack roll is a D20 Test that represents making an attack with a weapon, an Unarmed Strike, or a spell.
- [Cover](Cover.md): Cover provides a degree of protection to a target behind it.
- [Critical Hit](Critical-Hit.md): If you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you score a Critical Hit, and the attack hits regardless of any modifiers or the target's AC.
- [Grappling](Grappling.md): A creature can grapple another creature.
- [Improvised Weapons](Improvised-Weapons.md): An improvised weapon is an object wielded as a makeshift weapon, such as broken glass, a table leg, or a frying pan.
- [Opportunity Attacks](Opportunity-Attacks.md): You can make an Opportunity Attack when a creature that you can see leaves your reach using its action, its Bonus Action, its Reaction, or one of its speeds.
- [Reach](Reach.md): A creature has a reach of 5 feet unless a rule says otherwise.
- [Unarmed Strike](Unarmed-Strike.md): Instead of using a weapon to make a melee attack, you can use a punch, kick, headbutt, or similar forceful blow.
- [Weapon](Weapon.md): A weapon is an object that is in the Simple or Martial weapon category.
- [Weapon Attack](Weapon-Attack.md): A weapon attack is an attack roll made with a weapon.
